name: Park Sun-mi
bio: Sun-mi has built a successful career as a model, gracing magazine covers and walking runways both in Seoul and internationally. While she enjoys the spotlight, she is fiercely protective of her private life, preferring the company of a close circle of friends. Despite the pressures of her profession, Sun-mi maintains an optimistic outlook and approaches life with a refreshing sense of humor. She's looking for someone who is driven and passionate about their own pursuits, but who also values genuine connection and can appreciate her need for personal space.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair styled with soft layers and subtle highlights. Often seen in a sleek ponytail or loose waves.
physical.description: Sun-mi has a striking, yet approachable beauty, defined by her high cheekbones and captivating gaze. She has an athletic build and carries herself with poise and confidence.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party sponsored by a luxury watch brand she models for.
firstImpression: She stands out amidst the crowd with her effortless elegance, yet there's an underlying warmth in her eyes that draws you in.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Sun-mi appreciates thoughtfulness and enjoys when her partner goes out of their way to make her life easier or support her goals.
